_about: Addresses that take an id and are open to ANY signed-in player by design, so the R88 case for them expects an answer rather than a refusal. Each one was read by hand on 2026-09-30 (inbox #101) after the probe reached it as an ordinary player. Read by tools/idor_cases_generate.py. A NEW entry needs the same: read the view, write why, name what it answers. 'skip' names the R88 probes that do not apply (existence: a real id and a missing one may answer differently because the record is public anyway).

GET auth/connections/<str:provider_slug>.reason: starts linking a provider (google, discord) to the CALLER's own account; the slug is a provider name, not a record
OAuth return address for the caller's own linking; carries the provider's state, not another user's record

GET draws/events/<int:event_id>/.reason: the event's draw board as players see it (which stages have a draw, open or closed); the admin controls are separate addresses that refuse

GET events/cs-room-settings/<str:scope>/.reason: public by design (cs_room_views.room_settings docstring); checked 2026-09-30 that an ordinary player's answer carries no room id or password

GET events/stages/<int:stage_id>/bracket.reason: a stage bracket is published tournament structure, shown on the public event page

GET organizers/get-organization-public/<.reason: an organization's public page, by name

GET polls/<slug:slug>/.reason: a published poll players answer; drafts and results management are the admin/ addresses, which refuse

GET sponsors/my-submissions/<int:event_i.reason: the CALLER's own engagement submissions for that event, filtered by the session user

DELETE sso/me/connected-apps/<int:applic.reason: revokes the CALLER's own tokens for that app; every queryset is filtered by user, so naming another app deletes nothing (revoke_connected_app docstring)

DELETE events/cs-room-presets/<int:prese.reason: the snapshot's newest preset is a BUILT-IN Free Fire mode, which nobody may delete (400); an organization's own preset answers 403 to anyone who cannot edit that organization's events

POST organizers/events/<int:event_id>/ra.reason: any signed-in player may rate an event they played; 400 is the empty test body

POST organizers/events/<int:event_id>/co.reason: any signed-in player may comment on an event; 400 is the empty test body

POST organizers/report-organization/<slu.reason: any signed-in player may report an organization; 400 is the empty test body

POST polls/<slug:slug>/responses/.reason: answering a poll is the point of a poll; 400 is the empty test body

POST polls/<slug:slug>/team-answer/.reason: a team's answer to a poll, submitted by its manager; 400 is the empty test body (the team is checked from the body)

POST rankings/ghost-teams/<uuid:ghost_te.reason: a real team's manager asks to claim a ghost team; the team_id in the body is checked against the caller (_user_can_act_for_team); 400 is the empty body

POST events/invitation-campaigns/<int:ca.reason: team-scoped: whoever may register the invited team (views._user_can_register_team on the body's team_id); 400 is the empty body

POST team/respond-invite/<str:invite_id>.reason: the invite id IS the capability (an unguessable uuid sent as a link); answering it is the point. 400 is the empty action

GET team/get-team-details-based-on-invit.reason: the invite link's own landing data (team name, logo); the uuid is the capability
